sloka: तस्य आस्यात् तु प्रवृत्तेन रुधिरौघेण तद् बिलम् ।पूर्णम् आसीत् दुराक्रामम् स्वनतः तस्य भूतले ॥४-१०-२१॥
transliteration: tasya āsyāt tu pravṛttena rudhiraugheṇa tad bilam ।pūrṇam āsīt durākrāmam svanataḥ tasya bhūtale ॥4-10-21॥

translations.english: That cavern became difficult to bear, filled on the ground with the flood of blood pouring from his mouth as he roared.
